Name: DataKey
Description: The identification of a storage location that will receive the created object

Name: Notify
Description: You can choose if you want to notify the change to observers

Name: Key
Description: Property name for the object (alternates with Value parameters). Key/Value pairs can be repeated; when no pair is given an empty object is created

Name: Value
Description: Property value for the object (alternates with Key parameters). Always paired with the preceding Key
